 Jessica Chastain Sets Broadway Return in Lost Lear 
 Corey Stoll and Michael Urie will co-star in the Dan Colley play this spring.
 November 11, 2026 
 By Logan Culwell-Block 
 Jessica Chastain, Corey Stoll, and Michael Urie
 Jessica Chastain is having a busy fall. She played a demonic matriarch in  Other Mommy , a country music singer in  Heartland , and she just announced a return to Broadway as....King Lear. Kind of. The two-time Tony nominee will return to Broadway in 2027 in a new play from playwright Dan Colley  called Lost Lear . Performances will begin at the Booth Theatre March 29, 2027, ahead of an April 23 opening night. Colley is also directing, and will be making his Broadway debut as both a director and playwright.
 The play centers on former actor Joy, whose dementia has convinced her she’s in rehearsals to play Shakespeare’s Lear, and care home nurse Liam is all too happy to play the supporting roles whenever necessary. When her estranged son, Conor, visits hoping to get some things off his chest, he learns he’ll have to step into the drama, too. The play comes to the Main Stem after a 2022 debut in Dublin, later earning a Scotsman Fringe First Award at the 2025 Edinburgh Festival Fringe.
 Joining Chastain as Joy onstage will be Corey Stoll as Conor and Michael Urie as Liam. Casting is by Taylor Williams .
 "I never imagined, when we first made Lost Lear , that it would one day be on Broadway—and I've imagined some pretty wild things," says Colley in a statement. "I'm so thrilled to have the opportunity to share this piece with New York audiences and to discover new facets of the work through collaborating with this remarkable company of artists."
 The production will bring Chastain back to the Main Stem after earning Tony nominations for her work in  A Doll's House in 2023 and  The Heiress in 2012. Stoll, a Tony nominee for his work in 2023's  Appropriate , has also appeared on Broadway in  A View From the Bridge ,  Old Acquaintance , and  Henry IV . Urie became something of a Broadway baby after becoming a TV star on  Ugly Betty , with recent credits including  Oh, Mary! ,  Once Upon a Mattress , and  Spamalot .
 The production will feature production design by Scott Pask , lighting design by Heather Gilbert , sound design by Cody Spencer , projection design by Hana S. Kim and Yana Biryukova, and music by Daniel McAuley . Juniper Street Productions is serving as production manager, with 101 Productions' Christopher Taggart as general manager. Rachel Bauder will be production stage manager.
 Tickets are currently on sale via Telecharge . Visit LostLearBroadway.com .
